_note: One row per audit finding. `verifiedBy` says how the finding was established; `reCheck` is a portable command that re-establishes it against the tree. A finding with verifiedBy=INFERRED_FROM_CALLSITE may not be actioned until its reCheck confirms it — scripts/audit/recheck.ts acts on that rule, and docs/audit/finding-schema.ts is the shape. The v1.0 audit had neither field, which is how BOLT-004 was actioned against an alias that was real.
